texts.facts: The M/S Zenith-Event & Services & Anr vs State Of Himachal Pradesh & Ors on 15 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136498941/ 2 petitioner has invoked writ jurisdiction of this Court against the cancellation of its Rate Contract by the respondents on 10.07.2023. Being L1 bidder, the petitioner was awarded the contract on 20.04.2023. Agreement between the petitioner and respondents was executed on 21.04.2023.

4. Consideration .
4(i) The respondents have admitted awarding Rate Contract to the petitioner on 20.04.2023 and cancelling it on 10.07.2023.

Two reasons cited by the State Level Committee in its meeting dated 07.06.2023 have been reiterated by the respondents in their reply for cancelling petitioner's Rate Contract:-
a) Instead of forfeiting the Earnest Money Deposit of two part

b) Participating bidders 'M/s A to Z Solutions' and 'M/s Zenith-Event & Services'
(present petitioner) were owned by single proprietor-Sh. Harish Kumar.
The question whether the EMD ought to have been returned or forfeited in case of two bidders who had withdrawn their bids, can in no manner influence the Rate Contract awarded to the petitioner.
It is not understandable as to how action or inaction of department in returning/forfeiting the .
Earnest
Money Deposit of the other bidders, can have any impact upon the declared successful bidder.
It is not a case, where the respondents found the petitioner to be non-compliant of the tender conditions.
Seemingly, the respondents have mechanically put forth a reason to cancel the tender awarded to the petitioner on 20.04.2023, which has no relevance to the award of tender in petitioner's favour.
It is not for the petitioner to ensure that the department acts as per law.

The petitioner cannot be put to loss on account of department's alleged non-compliance to the tender condition in case of other bidders, more so when same cannot have any impact upon the tender awarded to the petitioner.
4(iii) Single Proprietor
The petitioner has provided enough documentary evidence to suggest that 'M/s A to Z Solutions' and 'M/s Zenith- Event & Services' are distinct legal entities.
The petitioner is a partnership firm consisting of two partners namely Sh. Partap Chand and Sh. Harish Kumar, whereas 'M/s A to Z Solutions' is a proprietorship concern of Sh. Harish Kumar.
It is not in dispute that both the concerns have their separate registrations with statutory authorities, as well as independent/separate account numbers.

.

3 Petitioner, a partnership concern is separately registered under H.P. (Shop & Commercial Establishment) Act, 1969, also as a Micro Small & Medium Enterprise, having separate GST, PAN numbers.
It also enjoys separate registration under Food Safety & Standard Authority of India, has separate EPF & ESI registration.

Merely because one of the partners in the petitioner firm has his own sole proprietorship concern in the name of M/s A to Z Solutions, in the given case, will not dis-entitle petitioner No.1 firm to participate in the tender process and for

The fact that 'M/s A to Z solutions' had withdrawn its bid before opening of technical bids finds mention in the "Proceeding of Technical bid opening and evaluation summary"
(Annexure R-5), relevant portion of which reads as under:-
"There

All the documents submitted online by the above bidders in the technical bids, which were scrutinized by the committee with the respect to terms and conditions, eligibility criteria and check list of the tender document.

On the basis of above scrutiny the bids were evaluated as under:-"
Learned Additional Advocate General could not point out any term and condition of the tender document debarring those firms from participating in the tender process, who had
It is for the respondents to incorporate and have proper terms and conditions in the tender document.
5. In view of above, it is apparent that the reasons given by the respondents for cancelling the award of contract issued in favour for the petitioner firm are not justifiable.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed.

Letter dated 10.07.2023 conveying the decision of the respondents to cancel the Rate Contract issued to the petitioner on 20.04.2023 for providing cooked diet service at MGMSC Khaneri, Rampur Bushahr for the years 2023-25 is quashed and set
The respondents are directed to proceed .
